message.content:
Sure thing! To make the plan as useful as possible, could you let me know a bit more about your trip?

| What you’d like to know | Why it matters |
|------------------------|----------------|
| **Length of stay** (days) | Helps set the pace and number of sights. |
| **Travel dates / season** | Weather, crowd levels, and special events vary. |
| **Budget** (per person, approximate) | Determines accommodation, dining, and activity choices. |
| **Interests** (art, history, food, shopping, nightlife, day‑trips, etc.) | Lets me highlight the right attractions. |
| **Travel style** (luxury, mid‑range, budget, solo, family, couple, etc.) | Affects transport, lodging, and dining options. |
| **Any must‑see or must‑do items** | Ensures they’re included. |

If you’re not sure about any of those, just give me a rough idea (e.g., “about a week in late spring, mid‑budget, love museums and good food”) and I’ll craft a tailored itinerary for you.
